leads.claim: Astronauts observed debris following spacecraft separation and fairing jettison.
leads.why: The debris is explicitly identified as components of the spacecraft (fairing, squibs) during standard flight operations.

leads.claim: Discussion regarding the size of tissue used during spaceflight.
leads.why: The context refers to personal hygiene or cleaning supplies used by astronauts, not biological UAP material.

doc_verdict: This document is a transcript of NASA post-flight debriefings regarding spacecraft operations and contains no information suggesting the recovery or analysis of UAP-related material.
